verification.word_id_source: November 2025 HSK 3.0 examination syllabus; cumulative official IDs 1001–2000. Homographs and numbered entries preserved as separate records.
verification.sentence_policy: One short conversational example for Anki and one plain written/descriptive example, both demonstrating the designated entry. Written style is not necessarily formal or literary.
verification.translation_policy: Meanings and both example sentences and translations are original editorial enrichment, not official HSK sentences and not independently native-speaker certified.
verification.pinyin_policy: Headword pinyin from November 2025 exam syllabus transcription. Sentence pinyin is algorithmically generated with HSK 1–4 lexicon, contextual overrides, and ICU character transliteration; review by fluent readers is required before authoritative pronunciation use.
verification.taxonomy_policy: Reuse unchanged 20 topic and 17 POS category definitions across HSK Levels 1–4. Topic assignments are editorial, not official HSK classification.
verification.vocabulary_boundary_policy: Target cumulative HSK 3.0 Levels 1–4 (official IDs 1–2000). All newly revised examples must pass the character/lexicon coverage screen; character coverage alone cannot certify that every complete lexical word is in the syllabus. Naturalness, word segmentation, collocation and pinyin require linguistic review.
verification.quality_control_1_0_1: Targeted review of demonstrative senses, polyphonic readings, classroom-natural phrasing, redundant clauses and misclassified concrete nouns. Does not constitute an exhaustive native-speaker audit of all 2,000 sentences.
